item.description:
Blinky 1.5.18

  • A reset card's detail closes when you click away. A click outside the date and Use panel closes it, and the Token window still closes only from its close button. #79
  • A row with no reset cards says None. Codex, Zhipu, and z.ai use that word when the count is zero and when the service did not report a count. #79
  • The Token window's notes are two short sections. About these figures still starts closed, and opening it shows the estimate as one section and each unread source on its own line. #79
  • The predicted reset names a global reset or a reset card. When Codex Resets sends a type with the scheduled time, that word sits beside the countdown, and Last reset uses the same words. A forecast with no type stays unlabeled. #79
